name: Coordinated Blast [Teamwork]
body:
With trained precision, you create safe pockets within the areas of your ally’s spells, inside which your allies remain safe.

Prerequisite(s): Spellcraft 5 ranks, any ancestral spell-like ability.

Benefit(s): Whenever your ally uses a spell or ability with an area (such as fireball or channel energy) with you in it, you can exclude any number of allies from that area of effect.
